title: Canonical site-return triangle on the two overlap branches
statement: For a cartesian square g : X → Y over b and opens U,V in Y, let A in D(U) and E in D(X) be identified after restricted pullback to g⁻¹(U). If θ = κ followed by the inverse-site image of this identification and the site-return unit, then after overlap restriction and the apex equivalence, θ followed by the apex-object comparison equals κ followed by openSiteOverlapIso, the site counit under the cartesian stage equivalence, and the fixed stage-object comparison. The same assertion holds for the V branch.

source.place: Compatibility of derived pullback and open restriction; composition as in Tag 0D5S.

proof.text: Substitute the prescribed formula for theta. Expand its three isomorphism factors and apply functoriality. The overlap-return triangle replaces the return map by the open-site comparison. Naturality moves the local object identification to the other edge; the nested site counit and its inverse cancel. The fixed stage-object comparison remains. Repeat with the right inclusion for the V branch.

lean.statement: theorem perfectOverlapCanonicalSiteTriangleU {X Y S T : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) (pX : X ⟶ T) (pY : Y ⟶ S) (b : T ⟶ S) (hg : IsPullback g pX pY b) (U V : Y.Opens) (A : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme) (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (φ : (derivedPullback (g ∣_ U)).obj A ≅ (schemeOpenRestriction X (g ⁻¹ᵁ U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E) : let P := g ⁻¹ᵁ U let Q := g ⁻¹ᵁ V let i : P ⊓ Q ⟶ P := homOfLE inf_le_left let RU := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) P).mapDerivedCategory let RW := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (P ⊓ Q)).mapDerivedCategory let SP := (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) i).mapDerivedCategory let LU := (overlapSiteInverse P).mapDerivedCategory let τ : RU ⋙ SP ≅ RW := (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _).symm ≪≫ Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso (SheafOfModules.overFunctorMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) i) let eW : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over (P ⊓ Q)) ≌ SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (P ⊓ Q).toScheme.toRingedSpace) := Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (P ⊓ Q) let apex := perfectOverlapApexEquivalence g pX pY b hg U V let cart := perfectOverlapStageEquivalence g pX pY b hg U V ∀ (M : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over P))) (κ : M ≅ LU.obj ((derivedPullback (g ∣_ U)).obj A)) (θ : M ≅ RU.obj E), θ = κ ≪≫ LU.mapIso φ ≪≫ (openSiteReturnIso X P).app E → apex.functor.map (SP.map θ.hom) ≫ apex.functor.map (τ.hom.app E) ≫ (perfectOverlapApexObjectIso g pX pY b hg U V U inf_le_left A E φ).hom = apex.functor.map (SP.map κ.hom) ≫ apex.functor.map ((openSiteOverlapIso X i).hom.app ((derivedPullback (g ∣_ U)).obj A)) ≫ cart.functor.map (eW.mapDerivedCategory.counitIso.hom.app ((schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X i).mapDerivedCategory.obj ((derivedPullback (g ∣_ U)).obj A))) ≫ ((perfectOverlapStageObjectIso g pX pY b hg U V U inf_le_left).app A).hom
